column1: # One executable rule for the agent role URI, read by the agent
# A SAN URI is a role URI when its scheme is sard and its host is roles
# (both case-insensitive); a certificate must carry exactly one, written
# Each row is <uri><TAB><outcome> for a certificate whose SAN carries that
# single role-candidate URI next to the agent identity:
#   missing           not a role URI, so no role
#   invalid           a role URI that is not written exactly
# Only URIs that both Go x509.ParseCertificate and Java
# URIs and the order of names are module-local cases. sard://[roles]/source
# is left out: Go refuses to parse a certificate that carries it.
